title: Do Implicit Personalization and Explicit Styles Conflict? PsPLUG: A Lightweight Plug-in for Balancing Personalization and Style in Customized LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2601.06362v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Personalized large language models are often expected to follow explicit style instructions, yet we find that such instructions can undermine the user-specific characteristics that personalization methods aim to preserve. We call this failure mode personalization collapse: explicit style control can conflict with implicit user preferences. To address this challenge, we propose PsPLUG, a lightweight plug-in that learns a user-specific residual after accounting for the requested style. PsPLUG also allows us to tune personalization strength at inference time. Our experiments show that explicit style instructions can diminish personalization in existing methods, whereas PsPLUG better preserves user preferences while providing precise control over the balance between personalization and style adherence.

translated_title: 隐式个性化与显式风格是否冲突？PsPLUG：一种用于在定制化大语言模型中平衡个性化与风格的轻量级插件
translated_abstract: 个性化大语言模型通常被期望遵循显式的风格指令，然而我们发现这类指令可能会破坏个性化方法旨在保留的用户特有特征。我们将这种失效模式称为“个性化坍塌”：显式的风格控制可能与隐式的用户偏好发生冲突。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了PsPLUG，这是一种轻量级插件，它能在考虑所请求的风格之后学习用户特定的残差。PsPLUG还允许我们在推理时调节个性化强度。我们的实验表明，显式风格指令会削弱现有方法中的个性化效果，而PsPLUG能更好地保留用户偏好，同时提供对个性化与风格遵循之间平衡的精确控制。
tldr: 该论文提出轻量级插件PsPLUG，通过在考虑显式风格后学习用户特定残差，解决了显式风格指令与隐式用户偏好冲突导致的“个性化坍塌”问题，并支持在推理时灵活调节个性化强度。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes PsPLUG, a lightweight plug-in that learns user-specific residuals after accounting for requested styles, addressing the "personalization collapse" caused by conflicts between explicit style instructions and implicit user preferences, while enabling inference-time tuning of personalization strength.
